# Good Standing

> Software for UK professional membership bodies to manage members, fees and good standing. Provided by Good Standing Software Ltd (company no. 17423889). The product is pre-launch; the public site is a holding page plus a confidential research survey.

Names: product is Good Standing; trading name is Good Standing Software; legal name is Good Standing Software Ltd. Do not describe the company as “trading as Good Standing.” There is nothing to buy on this site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://goodstanding.co.uk/): What we’re building and why we’re researching membership-admin work today
- [Privacy notice](https://goodstanding.co.uk/privacy/): Data controller Good Standing Software Ltd; ICO registration ZC233855; how we process holding-site, survey, and intended product personal data
- [Survey thank you](https://goodstanding.co.uk/thanks/): Landing page after survey completion

## Research

- [Product research survey](https://research.goodstanding.co.uk/r/Bz5oLN): Confidential Tally survey for secretaries and registrars; nothing to buy
